تستعرفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَعْرِفُوا (tastaʕrifū) /tas.taʕ.ri.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
# تُسْتَعْرَفُوا (tustaʕrafū) /tus.taʕ.ra.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَفَ (istaʕrafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
